title: docs(permissions): recipe for locking a position's fields once a record reaches a stage (field permission when)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9SG7rbUyLNjoTR3C1zMwjh7)_
Fixes #26178
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

An administrator-facing recipe for the field permission `when` ("at this stage, these people may no longer change these fields"), which until now only the developer reference described.

- `content/docs/permissions/access-recipes.mdx`: a new row in the layer table, and a recipe **Lock fields for a position once a record reaches a stage** on the card's contract case (finance edits drafts, but `governing_law` / `liability_cap` freeze once `status in ["approved", "signing", "active"]`). It carries the editor path (Setup, Access Control, Permission Sets, open the set, expand the object, field row, **When (edit)**, Add condition), the same entries as `definePermissionSet` metadata, how to choose (a lock for everyone is a validation rule; a lock that depends on who edits is a field permission `when`), and the four boundaries from the card: edit only, same-object fields only, the stored record before the write on update, and it locks but does not grant under the most-permissive merge.
- `content/docs/permissions/administrator-guide.mdx` Step 5: the field-level security bullet now names the **When (edit)** condition and points to the recipe.
- `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`: the `when` section links to the recipe.

The recipe's metadata block is a self-contained `{/* os:check */}` example, so `check:skill-examples` type-checks it against `@objectstack/spec` from now on.

## Evidence

- The block parses against `PermissionSetSchema` from `packages/spec/src` (one-off `tsx` run, not committed): recipe snippet `success: true`; negative control `readable: false` beside the same `when` is refused at `fields.clm_contract.governing_law.when` with the schema's own message ("A `when` reaches the EDIT vote only ...").
- Reverse check of the pin, on committed head 70e79e2d: renaming `when` to `whenn` in the block turns `check:skill-examples` red (exit 1, TS2561 at `access-recipes.mdx:67:70`, "Did you mean to write 'when'?"); restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, blob `2c041d93` matches HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Studio labels checked against `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (`perm.field.when` = "When (edit)", `perm.field.when.add` = "Add condition") and `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` (the condition cell shows only while Read is on).

## Gates (head 70e79e2d)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 44 commands derived; all 44 run, each exit captured before any pipe, all exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 44 derived, 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (derived from recorded exit codes). Includes `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:doc-anchors` (606 fragment links resolve), `pnpm check:role-word`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` (263 marked examples, up from 262).
- The lychee link check (`Check Documentation Links`, advisory) has no local binary here: NOT MEASURED locally, read from this PR's check run. Every new link targets an existing page (`/docs/data-modeling/validation`, `/docs/permissions/authorization`, `/docs/permissions/field-level-security`, `/docs/permissions/access-recipes`), and the anchors are covered by `check:doc-anchors` above.

## Acceptance notes

- `check:role-word` refused the first draft's word "role" in prose (ADR-0090 D3), so the recipe is titled for a **position**, the administrator's unit of assignment. The card's own wording used the reserved word; nothing else changed in meaning.
- Docs only: nothing published moves, so `skip-changeset`.
